items.text: sim change karna hai
number port karna hai
abhi chaahiye
haan ji
thoda ruk jaiye
nahi chahiye

items.context: Kya aap apne number ko port karna chahte hain?
items.text: haan ji

items.context: Kab tak aapko sim swap chahiye?
items.text: abhi karwa dijiye

items.context: Kya aapko naya sim kal tak chahiye?
items.text: kal tak theek rahega
mera number port karwana hai Gurgaon se Delhi
sim replacement ke liye form bharna hai mera naam Ramesh hai
kya main apne aadhaar ke bina bhi number port kar sakta hoon
meri sim chori ho gayi thi toh nayi milegi kya
port karne mein kitna samay lagta hai lagbhag
main Lucknow se Mumbai shift ho raha hoon toh sim kaise banwaya jaye
mobile number transfer karwana hai par main documents ready nahi kar paya

items.context: Apka naam aur address kya hai?
items.text: mera naam Neha Singh hai aur main Kalyanpur me rehti hoon

items.context: Sim replacement ke liye aapko kya documents ready karne hain?
items.text: mujhe agar sim swap karna hai toh kya documents chahiye

items.context: Kya aapka account ka bill balance clear hai?
items.text: mera last bill amount clear ho gaya hai ab port karwa sakte hain

items.context: Kya aapke paas landline number bhi port karwana hai?
items.text: mera landline number bhi port karwana hai kya possible hai

items.context: Port transfer process me kitna samay lagta hai?
items.text: kitne din lagenge port transfer me Delhi se Noida
mera naam Amit Kumar hai aur main Noida ka rehne wala hoon main apna number Airtel se Jio mein port karwana chahta hoon
mere paas sim card kharab ho gaya tha isliye mujhe nayi sim lena hai to kya documents chahiye hongi
main Mumbai me hoon aur mera number Delhi ka hai kya main apne number ko Mumbai me sim swap karke use kar sakta hoon

items.context: Kya aapka recent bill payment clear hai port ke liye?
items.text: mera bill pending tha but ab sab clear kar diya hai kya main port karva sakta hoon abhi

items.context: Aapke paas porting code available hai kya?
items.text: mujhe pata nahi mera porting code hai ya nahi aur main kaise check karun Mumbai me

items.context: Kya aap sim replacement ke liye request karna chahte hain?
items.text: main Chennai me rehta hoon aur mera 4G sim nahi chal raha hai kya main sim replace karwa sakta hoon

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: telecom
Intent: port_or_sim - wants to port the number, replace or swap a SIM
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with names, addresses or places; some phrased as questions

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
